The identity key/JWK pair is a randomly generated, public test-only RSA fixture for signed OIDC token verification and malicious-claim regressions. It is intentionally disclosed, has no relationship to any service/account, and must never be used for deployment. Production uses the configured provider's HTTPS JWKS and has no copy of its signing key.

The identity TLS CA/server certificate and server key are intentionally disclosed loopback-only test fixtures, valid October 2026–September 2036. They establish certificate verification and the real HTTPS code/JWKS exchange against `identity_provider.py`, which validates the test code, client credentials and PKCE challenge. They must never be trusted or deployed outside this isolated test. Regenerate them before expiry. The provider does not represent a real vendor or certify a vendor integration.
